answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7915 Country: India Title: I WANTED TO KNOW IS IT BAD TO SEE ANIMALS IN DREAMS? LAST TWO MONTHS I USED TO SEE SHEEPS AND GOATS AND COWS FOLLOWING ME. AND TWO TO THREE TIMES SNAKES HAD ALSO BITEN ME .WHAT DOES IT MEAN? Question: ASAK,I WANTED TO KNOW IS IT BAD TO SEE ANIMALS IN DREAMS? LAST TWO MONTHS I USED TO SEE SHEEPS AND GOATS AND COWS FOLLOWING ME. AND TWO TO THREE TIMES SNAKES HAD ALSO BITEN ME .WHAT DOES IT MEAN? Answer ID: 7915 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1594/1509=D/1429) It is indication that you shall have worldly gains in which it is feared to have some harm from any enemy; therefore you should keep on doing good deeds and shunning from sins. However, whatever will be destined by Allah will surely happen. You neither need to wait nor get afraid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
